contents.text: Which valve supplies seal water to pump P-202?

The seal-water valve that supplies seal water to pump P-202 is valve V-115. This valve is not the one to close for pump isolation. The manual for pump P-202 is the CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Manual (2009).

SOP-FS-007: Pump isolation and lockout › Seal-water valves at Riverside
## Seal-water valves at Riverside
At the Riverside plant, the seal-water valve for each pump carries the pump's tag with the prefix V: valve V-114 feeds pump P-201.
Don't close V-114 itself for isolation; close the isolation valve upstream of the strainer, so that V-114's setting is kept.
